RATE SCHEDULE AND TARIFF INFORMATION

Schedule: Residential Rate Tariff
Utility: Mountain Valley Electric Cooperative
Effective Date: January 1, 2024

Residential Electricity Tariff Structure

Service and Facility Charge: $12.50/month
  Customer charge for meter and billing services

Energy Charge:
  Summer (June-September): $0.1245/kWh
  Winter (October-May): $0.1089/kWh
  Shoulder (Spring/Fall): $0.1150/kWh

Demand Charge (for customers with greater than 25 kW demand):
  Only applicable to commercial customers in certain rate tariff schedules

Fuel and Purchased Power:
  Summer: $0.0345/kWh
  Winter: $0.0256/kWh

Adjustment Factors:
  Power factor adjustment: Applied when power factor falls below 0.95 lagging
  Seasonal rate adjustments apply to all electricity tariff rates

Minimum Monthly Bill: $15.00

This tariff is subject to regulatory approval and may be modified by the Public Utilities Commission.
